hero.heading: Sessions in Leeds
hero.subtext: Mindset coaching, career coaching and Vedic numerology for women ready to move beyond self-doubt and make confident decisions at work and at home. Meet in person, or online from wherever you are.

intro.heading: Change that starts from the inside out
intro.body:
I'm Shanila Khan, a certified confidence and mindset coach and Vedic numerologist based in Leeds. For more than a decade I have helped women through career changes, big life transitions and the quiet sense that they are meant for more.

My work starts with your inner journey: the beliefs and stories that shape every decision you make. When those shift, confidence follows, and so does action.

offerings.heading: How I can help
offerings.subtext: All available in person or online.

items.title: Mindset Coaching
items.description: My signature 12-week, one-to-one programme for women ready to get clear on their goals, values, decisions and direction.

items.title: Career Coaching
items.description: The career edition of my mindset coaching, for career change, redundancy, burnout or feeling stuck at work.

items.title: Numerology
items.description: A one-hour Vedic numerology session for focused insight into a decision, relationship or life transition.

whoIHelp.heading: Who I help
whoIHelp.items:
Women at a crossroads, struggling to make a decision
Professionals feeling stuck, uninspired or burnt out at work
Women going through a big life change, from becoming a parent to moving home
Women ready to stop playing small and trust themselves again

inPerson.title: In person
inPerson.body: Prefer to meet face to face? We can meet in Leeds and agree the details when you book.

online.title: Online
online.body: We meet over Zoom, Google Meet or your preferred platform, wherever you are in the world, at a time that suits your time zone.

whyShanila.points:

items.question: Where do your sessions take place?
items.answer: I'm based in Leeds and meet clients in person there. I also work online, so you can book from anywhere in the world.

items.question: Can I work with you if I don't live in Leeds?
items.answer: Yes. Many of my clients work with me online from across the UK and abroad. Online sessions follow the same programme as in-person ones.

items.question: How do online sessions work across time zones?
items.answer: Sessions take place over Zoom, Google Meet or your preferred platform. When you book, we'll find a time that works for your time zone.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: Women navigating change at work or at home who feel stuck, doubt themselves or sense they're meant for more, and who are ready to make confident decisions.

items.question: How long are the sessions?
items.answer: Mindset Coaching and Career Coaching are 12-week, one-to-one programmes. Numerology is a single one-hour session.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Book a free discovery call. We'll talk about where you are now and which kind of support would help most, with no obligation.

closingCta.heading: Ready to take the first step?
closingCta.body:
Book a free discovery call.

**We'll find the right fit together.**
